name: AutoML Asset
description: Real AutoML for tabular data: searches across model families (LightGBM, XGBoost, random forest, extra trees, linear models, ...) via FLAML and picks the winner -- unlike ml_pipeline's grid_search/random_search/bayesian_search ops, which tune hyperparameters for a single model_type you already specify. Caches the winning recipe and does a cheap refit on every subsequent run instead of always re-searching.

inputs.description: Input DataFrame with a target column and feature columns.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame with a predictions column added.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame

feature_columns.label: Feature Columns
feature_columns.description: Feature columns to train on. Defaults to every column except target_column. Non-numeric columns are auto-label-encoded (see README).

state_path.label: State Path
state_path.description: fsspec path (local or cloud -- s3://, gs://, etc.) where the winning AutoML recipe is cached between runs. Required -- this is what makes repeated materializes cheap instead of always re-searching.

refresh_search.label: Refresh Search
refresh_search.description: Force a full fresh search even if a cached recipe exists at state_path (and overwrite it with the new result). Use for a one-off re-tune; for automatic periodic re-tuning use max_state_age_hours instead.

max_state_age_hours.label: Max State Age Hours
max_state_age_hours.description: If the cached recipe is older than this, treat it as stale and run a fresh full search instead of a cheap refit. None (default) never auto-expires the cache.

time_budget_seconds.label: Time Budget Seconds
time_budget_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget for a full search (ignored for a cached cheap refit, which always takes well under a second regardless of this value).

estimator_list.label: Estimator List
estimator_list.description: Restrict the search to these FLAML estimator names (e.g. ['lgbm', 'rf', 'xgboost']). None (default) lets FLAML choose from its full built-in set for the task type.

metric.label: Metric
metric.description: FLAML search metric (e.g. 'accuracy', 'f1', 'r2', 'rmse'). None (default) uses FLAML's own default for task_type.

test_size.label: Test Size
test_size.description: Held-out fraction for the honest evaluation metrics in output metadata (never used for the search itself).

random_state.label: Random State
random_state.description: Random seed for the train/test split and FLAML's own internal splits.

output_column.label: Output Column
output_column.description: Column to write predictions into (on ALL input rows, using the final fitted model).

model_output_path.label: Model Output Path
model_output_path.description: Optional fsspec path to also persist the final fitted model via joblib (e.g. for use outside this asset). None (default) skips this.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when include_preview_metadata is True.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date (ISO), required for time-based types.
